meaning: (Qal) to love, be attached to, long for

renderings.kjv: Because he hath set his love

elsewhere.note: Hamor talked with them, saying, “The soul of my son, Shechem, longs for your daughter. Please give her to him as a wife.
All the pillars of the court around shall be filleted with silver; their hooks of silver, and their sockets of bronze.
Yahweh didn’t set his love on you nor choose you, because you were more in number than any people; for you were the fewest of all peoples;
all the storage cities that Solomon had, the cities for his chariots, the cities for his horsemen, and that which Solomon desired to build for his pleasure in…
and Baalath, and all the storage cities that Solomon had, and all the cities for his chariots, the cities for his horsemen, and all that Solomon desired to…
“Because he has set his love on me, therefore I will deliver him. I will set him on high, because he has known my name.
Behold, for peace I had great anguish, but you have in love for my soul delivered it from the pit of corruption; for you have cast all my sins behind your back.
